messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: High error rate detected for prod-inference-gateway: 5xx spike (10m) — rate: 18% errors, p95 latency 1.8s. Pager triggered for SRE oncall.
alice (oncall): taking pager, joining.
alice (oncall): seeing gateway logs, lots of upstream 502/503 from model-runner group.
matt (runtime): on it — pulling recent runner logs.
matt (runtime): paste logs: ```
[2026-03-17T02:12:05Z] model-runner-12: ERROR: runtime: segfault at 0x0 (signal 11)
[2026-03-17T02:12:05Z] model-runner-12: backtrace: quant_kernel.cpp:452 handle_attention()+0x1f3
[2026-03-17T02:12:06Z] model-runner-12: OOM: failed to allocate 128MB KV cache chunk
```
alice (oncall): segfault + OOM at the same time — could be quant kernel issue with large seqs. Any rollbacks?
sara (platform): traffic shows error concentration in region-us-west-2 and for model id redwood/llama-70b-quant.
matt (runtime): hypothesis: recent kernel change that pathologically breaks when KV-cache growth + quantized attention interacts on short-lived batches. I can disable quantized kernel for that model.
kevin (support): any customer-facing impact metrics? which customers hit it?
ops-bot: Notifying impacted customers based on request headers: customer_ids: [acme, finify, docsly] — estimated error-hit 11% of total acme traffic, 7% for finify.
csm-jane: pinging accounts team, prepping a blameless note.
matt (runtime): immediate mitigation plan: 1) disable quant attention kernel for redwood/llama-70b-quant on prod in us-west-2 2) reroute traffic for that model to fallback redwood/llama-70b-fp16 for latency-sensitive customers 3) scale up runner pool + restart unhealthy pods.
alice (oncall): execute mitigation A (disable quant kernel) now? say +1 to proceed.
matt (runtime): running admin command: ```
curl -X POST "https://admin.redwood/svc/runtime/feature-flags" -d '{"model":"redwood/llama-70b-quant","flags":{"quant_attention":false}}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACTED'
```
matt (runtime): flag applied to us-west-2. Patching live runners: ```
kubectl -n inference label pods -l app=model-runner region=us-west-2 maintenance=rolling
kubectl rollout restart deployment/model-runner-uw2
```
sara (platform): autoscaler bumped pool from 6->9 nodes in us-west-2.
alice (oncall): routing change: switching canary 20% to fp16 fallback for acme and finify. Command: ```
routingctl set-weight --model redwood/llama-70b-quant --region us-west-2 --to redwood/llama-70b-fp16 --weight 20
```
ops-bot: Canary in flight — monitoring for error rate.
matt (runtime): initial post-mitigation logs: ```
[2026-03-17T02:16:12Z] model-runner-12: kernel load: quant_attention disabled, using fp16 attention path
[2026-03-17T02:16:20Z] model-runner-13: allocation ok, KV-cache footprint reduced
```
alice (oncall): error rate dropping: now 6% across gateway (was 18%). p95 back to 900ms.
csm-jane: queued customer comms draft for acme & finify, marking message: "we observed elevated errors due to runtime kernel instability; mitigation applied; next steps include root-cause and postmortem."
kevin (support): triage channel says some API clients saw partial failures for long-context requests (>8k tokens). Recording for cust impact.
matt (runtime): next step: collect core dumps + sanitized stack traces from crashed pods prior to recycling; uploading to incident bucket. Command: ```
kubectl cp model-runner-12:/var/crash/core.123 /tmp/core.123
gsutil cp /tmp/core.123 gs://redwood-incidents/4960007777/
```
sara (platform): marking pager resolved? Alice, do you want to keep oncall for 1h for stability window.
alice (oncall): leaving oncall for now but will monitor for 45m. Handoff to matt for deeper debug.
matt (runtime): assigning follow-up ticket INF-3721 to investigate quant attention kernel and input-shape triggered allocation path; will include repro harness.
ops-bot: Incident created: https://incidents.redwood/4960007777 (status: mitigated).
csm-jane: notify legal/enterprise if we need to escalate comms.
kevin (support): Customer-impact summary: acme experienced ~11% failed requests between 02:12-02:20 UTC; finify ~7%. No data exfiltration suspected.
alice (oncall): tagging for postmortem — owners: matt (root cause), sara (infra), alice (mitigation), csm-jane (customer comms).
matt (runtime): quick note — workaround exposes small latency delta for affected requests (~+50ms) but restores success rate. Will test patch and ship proper kernel fix next week.
alice (oncall): closing slack thread for now. Please add updates to incident doc and ping if error rate rises. :thumbsup:
